mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to this journey—a path that’s less about grand gestures and more about subtle, powerful shifts within. You know, the real move from amateur to professional isn’t usually about applause or dramatic change. It’s that quiet moment when something clicks inside us, and we start showing up for our calling with real commitment. In Turning Pro, Steven Pressfield takes us right into that world. He explores what it feels like to leave behind the distractions and resistance that keep us stuck in “amateur hour,” and instead, to step into discipline, courage, and honesty—even when it’s uncomfortable. This isn’t about chasing validation from the outside. It’s about that honest reckoning with ourselves—choosing to let go of excuses, and embracing a life that’s driven by purpose and authenticity. As our lives blur the lines between work, art, and personal growth, “turning pro” becomes so much more than a career move; it’s a way of living with intention, every single day. Pressfield’s wisdom gives us a peek into the daily struggles—how we face fears, battle procrastination, and keep going when things get tough. Together, we’ll explore what it truly means to show up—not just for our creative passions, but in every part of life. Each step forward is an invitation to claim our own potential, to live with deep commitment, and to transform not only what we do, but who we become. So, let’s dive in and discover how we can all answer the call to turn pro—starting right here, right now.
